payload.title: Run Jev ordering sensitivity on fixed selected examples
payload.description:
## Scope

Execute the frozen ordering protocol after the initial Jev single-order findings. Match targets and selected examples across permutations and report draw-by-order variation separately from example-selection and context-size effects. Keep this analysis ahead of other-model conclusions.

## Definition of done

The report includes every planned permutation, paired intervals versus the declared reference order, order robustness by policy/budget, and a documented order rule for the subsequent model matrix.
